holdout.purpose: synthetic structured-input generalization; not JevBench or natural-language accuracy

accuracy_selection.enable_facts_only_if: development raw correct strictly increases, wrong accepted does not increase, and candidate p95 <= 2x raw p95
accuracy_selection.accuracy_denominator: unique items; repeats measure stability and timing only

compute_selection.gate: complete paired outcomes, zero raw/accepted choice or input-token changes, probability/mass drift <= 0.02, median run p50 <= 0.95x baseline, worst run p95 <= 1.05x baseline

prefix_reuse.warmup: one ordinary untimed batch; resident scope opens after warmup
prefix_reuse.required: positive actual reused tokens, paired raw/accepted outcomes, score drift, first cold versus subsequent warm call timings, error recovery and drop isolation
